thread:
kai: Heads up - seeing connection failures for model-pulls from edge nodes in eu-central-1. NAT Gateway is hitting ephemeral port exhaustion, lots of TIME_WAIT on ELB -> NAT path. Anyone else? :eyes:

maria: Yep, saw spikes ~09:30 UTC. Affects model pull steady-state when new containers start. 503s from registry + S3 fetches.

infra-bot: alert: NATGW-EPHEMERAL:10% %t >= 90 for gw-rotary-eu-central-1a

ben: Logs show a ton of outbound sockets in TIME_WAIT on NAT ENI in the AZ. conntrack counters climbing too.

sasha: Could this be ALB/NLB idle timeout -> backend close -> client stuck in TIME_WAIT? What LB are we using on the edge?

kai: Edge uses ALBs for ingress and an internal NLB in front of our model sharders. Model pulls go direct to S3 (sigv4) and occasionally through our sidecar proxy.

maria: Repro: spawn 200 short-lived model-pull workers and NAT ports depleted within 2 mins. Root cause looks like many short TCP connections, no reuse, client-side ephemeral range default.

ben: Current mitigations: increased number of NAT Gateways in the AZ (still provisioning), and toggled connection_reuse on our sidecar (experimental) — reduced port churn locally by ~30%.

sasha: Two action items: 1) tune OS ephemeral port range + decrease TIME_WAIT with tcp_tw_reuse/tcp_fin_timeout where safe; 2) configure keepalives / connection pooling for model pulls.

kai: Agreed. Also exploring HTTP/2 multiplexing for registry pulls to reduce new TCP handshakes.

maria: Note: can't change kernel flags in hosted sidecars for some Dedicated customers. Need platform-wide fallback: an egress proxy that terminates and reuses connections to S3/registry on behalf of clients.

ben: Short-term hotfix: add additional NATGW per AZ and shift a portion of egress through a dedicated NAT instance pool that we can tune (conntrack, ephemeral range).

infra-bot: deploy: scaled natgw-eu-1 by +2 instances (in progress)

sasha: Long-term: implement edge egress-proxy autoscaler + client SDK to multiplex pulls. Also add observability: per-ENI ephemeral-port-used metric and per-AZ conntrack alerts.

kai: Can someone own the proxypool plan? @maria? ETA by EOD for the strategy doc?

maria: I'll take it. Will post a rough runbook + risk matrix by 16:00 UTC. Hotfix validation in staging now.

ben: Validation: staging model-pull test with 500 workers passed after connection_reuse + extra NATGW, 99.98% success.

sasha: Follow-up: create a runbook for incident ops (how to scale natgw, add route to proxy, rollback). Add playbook snippet:

```
aws ec2 allocate-address --domain vpc
aws ec2 create-nat-gateway --subnet-id subnet-xxx --allocation-id eipalloc-yyy
# update route table to point 0.0.0.0/0 to new natgw
```

kai: Thanks. I'm adding the runbook to eng-infra/mitigations and will kick off a postmortem if this recurs tomorrow. :thumbsup: 

maria: closing loop later with numbers (token costs, extra egress charges from added NATGW) — tagging finance for cost delta.

leo: FYI, increased NATGW costs will likely spike our monthly cloud bill; suggest we prefer proxy pattern long-term to avoid per-GB NATGW charges.

kai: last - please paste links to staging test logs and the metric dashboard when available.

maria: link: https://dash.re/redwood/natgw-eu-central1/ports (staging dashboard) and https://ci.re/build/4523 (staging run)

ben: ack
